text_block_list.text:
Despite my concerns, Голд Шипп puts on
a
fantastic showing in the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The sky is the limit from here on out!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that's another race done and
dusted.
Wheeew...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Being relaxed truly is the best weapon in
my
arsenal. Now, time to chillax...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Aaahhh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Hey, can't you see I'm getting my zen
on? Let's
take it slow.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
With my unique talents, I can even turn
a barren
wasteland into a plentiful carrot
farm in no time.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go show the world how great
it is to
live off the land.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
No matter how I try to call out to her,
Голд Шип
doesn't even spare me a
second glance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I make to go after her before she
disappears from
my view, but then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A shame, Golshi.

So you've chosen to turn away from the
life of
competition.
What the... Who's there?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Flash? What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
A certain individual asked me to act as a

messenger and relay missives to you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I was meant to deliver helpful
information to you
today...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But if you are withdrawing from racing,
then such
data is no longer relevant to
you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...What kind of info are we talking about
here?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Information that may aid your search for
Eden.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: What?! Did you say Eden?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: ...Um, what's that again?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! That curious and alluring
locale!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Flash, forget what I said before! Tell me
where
Eden is, I'm begging you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
So, you have changed your mind.
However, the
information I carry is of
vital importance. I cannot
simply give it
to you free of charge.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must first challenge you to
battle
upon the stage of the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen? Does that mean you'll
tell me if
I race you there?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Yes, without fail. You have my word.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Very well, you're on! Arima Kinen, here I
come!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm curious about the "certain individual"
who
gave Эйсин Флэш that information,
but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
More than that, I'm just glad Голд Шип
is
motivated to race again!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
